balls.text: he bowls it very full and Raut makes a lot of room and digs it out wide of cover point, Warne pushes the second and Rajasthan reach the psychological barrier of 150
he walks down the track and mows him over long-on, the length balls are not working for Anureet
Raut repeats the same scoop over cover point  and this time he clears the fielder at the deep, he makes room and gets a lot of elevation
slower ball and he makes room and swings and misses

excellent keeping! He makes room to a yorker on the legstump and there appears to be an inside edge and McCullum does well to dive to his left and take it one handed, the decision goes upstairs, the batsman gets the benefit of the doubt
he makes the mistake of overpitching and Raut gives it the treatment by making room and slamming it over cover point, the fielder had no cahnce
pushed to long-on
full on the stump and mowed to midwicket
fired in fast down the leg side
swings too early at another quick delivery and Gayle keeps him quiet again
tries to mow it to the on side but the ball clips his body
bowls it quick and short and steers it to the off side
fullish outside off and pushed down to long-off
loses control and strays too wide down the leg side
Mascarenhas gives himself room but the bowler cranks up the pace and bowls a yorker which sends the offstump back by a few yards, good over, save for the wides
slowish bouncer and Raut slices it to deep point
much shorter and Raut tries to slice it over the keeper again but the umpire penalises Anureet
good bouncer and Raut makes room to upper cut it but fails to make contact
keeps it short and he shuffles and tucks it down to the on side
slides down the leg side and wide called
outside off and pushed to the off side
Dropped But a tough one, it's a thick top edge and Hodge at long-on loses sight of it, the ball swirls in the air and he tries to pull off a one-handed catch but doesn't quite get near the ball
lucky escape for the batsman as he attempts a pull and checks the shot, the ball lands well clear of the fielders in the region of square leg
brute power and lovely placement, he makes room and bashes a pitched up delivery wide of mid-off and cover, that travelled like a bullet to the boundary
fails to pick the slower one and chops the ball hard back to the bowler
fullish outside the offstump and he steers it wide of point, Anureet mops up
goes for a hug heave over the on side but mis-hits it, stays rooted to the crease and gets a thick top edge, Yashpal fixes his gaze on the ball and takes the catch comfortably at short mid-off
makes a lot of room to heave him over the on side but he mistimes the shot and takes a single to deep midwicket
fires it full on the stumps and he squirts it down to long-off
full on middle and leg and forced to long-on
strays on the pads and he works it to deep square leg
full on the stumps and pushed back to the bowler
full outside off and he pushed hard wide of long-off
punches it wide of the diving point fielder
chips it very uppuishly wide of the short midwicket region

slower ball floated on the pads and the batsman is too early on the shot but he gets
a faint trickle past the diving short fine leg fielder
taps it towards cover point and takes a risky single and the throw is wide
he times the square drive very well and a misfield by Agarkar allows a second run
strays on the pads and he clips it down to square leg
it' s a low full toss and he hits hard to long-off
fires it full and he drives to mid-off
uses his feet and drives forcefully to long-off
chips down the track and mows it down to long-on
delivers from wide of the crease and Jadeja pushes hard through the line to long-off
the straighter one and he punches it down to long-off
lands on middle and leg and he tucks it to the on side
shuffles and clips it with the line down to fine leg
wide down the leg side and he fails to make contact as he tries to work it on its way
stays on the backfoot and punches this one down to mid-off
gives it more air and he softly nudges it down to mid-on
pushed in quick and flat and he defends safely
fullish on middle and off and he steers it towards point
full toss and he clips this to the on side
defends close to the pads and that prompts an appeal, the ball rolls to the off side and they take a run, that was a good shout as it was pad first
fullish on the offstump and worked down to long-on
lands on the pads and he works it to deep midwicket
gets a half prod forward and defends to the off side
taps it towards cover and thinks of a single but tells his partner to stay back
the straighter one and Mascarenhas does well to get his bat behind the line and defend
this one spins away from the right hander and catches the batsman at sea
lunges forward and taps it in front of point with soft hands and sets off
the incutter this time and he pushes it with the turn to mid-on
full outside off and driven towards Anureet at long-off, they push the second run and Ganguly breaks the stumps but it's too late
Dropped fractionally short and slashed hard, Shukla at point dives to his right, gets both hands behind the ball and fluffs it
fullish outside off and pushed wide of cover
softly nudged wide of mid-on for a single
slides down the leg side and clips his pads and Ganguly appeals for an lbw
Mascarenhas shoulders arms first up, the keeper is up to the stumps
very poor shot by the well-set Pathan, he tries to slog him against the spin and gets a thick top edge, Yashpal takes the skier easily at point
stays back and punches it to the off side
punched hard towards mid-off
full and pushed back to the bowler

Smith looked in trouble straightaway! He tries to force a full ball to the on side but the ball clips his pad in front of the stumps and lobs low to Gayle at first slip, Mendis goes up for the lbw and Mark Benson checks with his colleague if Gayle took it cleanly, replays confirmed that Smith edged the ball onto his pads, so he's out caught
takes the aerial route over the off side but the ball lands in the middle of nowhere
gives him width outside off and he crashes it just wide of extra cover, Yashpal mistimes his dive at the boundary but manages to pull it back  and relay the ball to another fielder
frees his arms and chops it hard wide of cover
gets forward and drives to Anureet Singh at long-off and that's the 50 stand
lands it on a good length outside off and he punches it down to deep point
full on middle and leg and worked to long-on
flat and quick on the pads and he works it to the on side for a single
mistimes the drive to the off side
full and hoicked along the turf wide of midwicket
takes the aerial route with a huge slog, he bisects the gap between two fielders and fetches a boundary to deep midwicket
tries to hoick him to the on side but the ball comes on quick, he ends up jabbing it back to the bowler
drifts on the pads and Smith steals a quick run, a direct hit by McCullum would have sent Smith packing
that's a low full toss and Yusuf gives it the treatment by smacking it across the line and over mid-on, boy is he in form
slower ball but too short and wide, Yusuf chases it and at the point of contact checks his shot, he manages to place it well enough wide of third man
the bowler gets away with this one as he strays on the pads, Yusuf was too early on the flick
slides down the leg side and wide called
makes room to an overpitched delivery outside off and he frees his arms and flays him over extra cover, very nearly cleared the rope
keeps it tight on that offstump line and Smith pushes forward and takes a quick single to point
fullish outside off and pushed softly to mid-off
fuller and he tries to biff this past mid-off but fails to beat mid-off, good fielding dada
too short and the ball kind of stops on him, that allows him to get right back and slam it wide of mid-off and cover
short and he pulls this one hard over square leg, he gets in position quickly and clubs him away
shuffles across his crease and pushes it hard down to mid-off
thick outside edge and it just falls short of Gayle at first slip, change of pace I reckon
keeps it full and Yusuf punches it hard down to mid-off
short and down the leg side and he swivels and pulls very effortlessly over fine leg, he didn't hit it too hard and the timing was perfect
plays a short arm pull to fine leg and a fumble by Ishant doesn't cost them another run
gets well forward again and pushes this towards point
fullish on the offstump and pushed with soft hands to mid-off
slower ball but it's yet another boundary ball, he swings across the line and clears square leg's reach
lovely shot! Ishant overpitches on middle and off and Yusuf has a freeswing of the arms and carts him for a huge six over the sightscreen
bangs it in short and hr has to duck quickly to evade that bouncer
keeps it a bit short and forces Yusuf to hop and defend
over confidence! Ishant dishes it out wide outside off and Quiney tries to slam him square of the wicket but gets a thick outside edge to Gayle at first slip
fractionally short and the ball sits up nicely for Quiney to club it over deep midwicket, nice swivel and follow through

nice judgement by Ishant at the boundary, it's short and wide and asking to be slashed hard but the upper cut fails to get the required distance, Ishant runs from third man towards deep point and hangs on to it
comes back in off the pitch and the ball clips his pad and lobs towards the keeper
nice shot by Valthaty! It's full and on the stumps and he pushes it hard through the line and beats mid-off comfortably
slides down the legside and the ball clips his pad en route to the keeper, prompts an optimistic appeal
fractionally short and wide outside off and he confidently punches it down to point
strays on the pads and he's a little too early on the shot as the ball rolls to the on side
draws him forward with a full delivery and he angles it down to third man
pacy delivery on the pads and he knocks it down to midwicket
steep bounce from over the wicket and Smith dangerously pokes at it
he gets forward and drives a full delivery past point to get off the mark
nudged off the pads to the on side and Smith calls quickly for the run
nice bounce and carry straightaway for Ishant, Smith leaves it alone and the keeper takes it in front of his face

It's a tie and a Super Over! Ishant cracks a full delivery outside off and Warne flings himself to his left and intercepts it, they take the second run and Kamran runs across, gathers the ball and flings it to the keeper, Ishant was nowhere in the frame

Oh boy what's happening here! Ganguly makes room and tries to slash a short and wide delivery and gets an outside edge to the keeper, Rawat asks the question but Kamran doesn't even look back, Ganguly can't believe what he's done
nudges it softly towards midwicket and they scamper hard for the second run and Ganguly makes it
Kamran fires it on the blockhole outside off and Ganguly chases it and his bat hits the pitch, Kamran reckoned there was bat on ball, no Sir, not even close
Agarkar bravely exposes his stumps to a full delivery and carves it down to deep extra cover
drifts on the pads and he whips it to fine leg, Agarkar has the strike
poor start, bowls it short and really wide outside off wide and Ganguly wisely lets it go
shuffles and clips it to the on side
Yashpal holes out to deep extra cover and Ganguly is livid! Yashpal makes room and scoops it straight to Raut, it was a poor ball but it didn't meet the approval of Ganguly
Yashpal goes for a wild slog to the on side and Ganguly has a word with him
Yashpal uses his feet against Warne and it earns him a boundary! It's full and he crashes it past the bowler and mid-on
shuffles and nudges it to the on side
he makes room and decides to leave the ball on seeing it pitch it wide outside off, Warne's not happy with Erasmus' wide call
stays back, swivels and pulls to fine leg
angles it on the pads and he works it down to long-on
chips down the track and pushes it to deep extra cover
a rank full toss and Yashpal steps down and adds a lot of muscle to that chip over cover, that scorched to the boundary
he field very well off his own bowling, intercepts a drive to long-off
makes room and tries to carve him over long-off but misses it completely and nearly loses his footing
down the leg side and flicked towards fine leg
stays back and pushes it with the turn to long-on, very easily negotiated over
rocks back and slaps it hard to deep extra cover
gets well forward and pushes it to long-off
The Prince gets better and better, he rocks back to a short of a length ball and pulls wide of square leg, these are genuine cricketing shots folks
rocks back and cuts wide of point, good fielding limits that to a single
this one doesn't turn and it beats the bat as he tries to cut
Free Hit And Ganguly goes one better! He gets underneath a full delivery and lofts him effortlessly high over long-off, the ball lands on the roof of the first tier awesome shot
take that! And it's a no ball as well, he drops it short and Ganguly stays at the crease, doesn't swivel much and he pulls it effortlessly over deep square-leg
lands outside off and he squeezes it wide of backward point
pounds it hard along the turf to long-off and Kamran does well to slide and cut it off
poor length and Yashpal makes him pay by making room, opening the face and scooping it wide of point, that should give him a lot of confidence
he stays at the crease and swats it past midwicket, not very well timed
bowls it full and he crashes it down to long-off and gives the strike to the senior partner
exposes his stumps and heaves him along the turf to long-on
goes for the drive and gets a thick inside edge to midwicket
lofts him down the ground and the ball dips towards long-on and just falls short of Paul Valthaty, good attempt all the same
cuts back in off the seam and he can only tap it straight to mid-on
cramps him for room and Yashpal softly defends back to the bowler
full outside off and he pushes it through the line to long-off

credit to the field placements for that dismissal, Bangar gets a fraction of width outside off and only manages to slice it on the up straight to Smith at backward point, he takes it low to his right, the pressure was on with the attacking field
cramps him for room and Bangar fails to pierce it past the packed off side field
fires the yorker wide outside off and Bangar fails to dig it out
stays at the crease and cuts uppishly wide of backward point
drifts down the leg side and another wide called, again Kamran thinks the ball clipped the pad, Warne;'s not too happy with this line
Smith does brilliantly at backward point to intercept a slash, he relays the ball to one of the other fielders
lands it outside off and he taps it wide of mid-off
just drifts down the leg side and the fielders look a bit surprised at Benson's wide call, did that clip the trousers?
full outside off and driven to the off side
he drifts on the pads and it;s too easy for Ganguly who shuffles and clips it away down to fine leg

nice improvisation from Sourav, he chips down the track to a full and wide delivery and decides to loft him over extra cover rather than over mid-off, the timing is good and the ball nearly carries over the rope
he fails to pierce the off side field as Warne moves quickly to his right at short cover and cuts it off
plays a neat drive square of the wicket on the off side, Munaf offers a lot of width
drops it with soft hands towards cover and Ganguly tells him to stay put
that's vintage Ganguly! He gets width outside off and doesn't try to over hit it, he gets beside the line and slices it effortlessly past cover point
the ball kicks up on Ganguly who first shapes to slice it and then decides to check his shot to point, hesitation in the running and Bangar struggles to get back and Kamran's throw is wide
full on the pads and the ball trickles to fine leg, Kamran appeals for whatever it's worth
gets away with a full toss down the leg side, too quick for Bangar
opens the face of the bat and steers him down to third man
clips his pads and just beats Rawat who falls to his left

the bowling change works and Rawat's in business again, Munaf teases him outside the offstump and gets the ball to move away off the seam, the ball takes the outside edge as Hodge prods forward half heartedly
fullish in length outside off, he gets the bat down quickly and squeezes it past the diving short cover fielder
bowls a nice stump to stump line and Ganguly can only push it softly to mid-off
lands it a trifle wide outside off and Ganguly opts to let it go
drops it with soft hands in front of cover point and sets off
he's watchful outside the offstump, he safely shoulders arms

That's a stunner from the keeper! Rawat take a bow! Shukla makes room to crash it past the covers but only manages a thick inside edge, the ball dips on the keeper who moves quickly to his left and takes it one-handed on the slide, he's made up for dropping that skier earlier
keeps it on a good length and he steers it to the off side
short and he mistimes the pull to mid-on
comes on quite quick and he hops at the crease and takes a sharp single to cover,  Jadeja hits the stumps at the bowlers end but the batsman's safe
slings it outside the off stump and he gets forward and slices it down to point
gives it more air and he commits to the sweep a little too early, the ball rolls to the on side
slips in the flipper and he stays back and knocks it down the track
floated on the pads and he gets down and sweeps to deep square-leg
he makes room and slices it on the up and picks up a couple, the fielder at deep cover mops up

a very valuable wicket for Rajasthan, Warne invites Gayle to go for the loft over the sight screen by giving the ball a lot of air, Gayle stays at the crease and mis-hits it, Jadeja runs across from long-on and takes the skier
a watchful Gayle defends very softly off the front foot
excellent improvisation from Shukla, he stays back, waits for the ball to come on to him before deliberately slicing it wide of short third man
drifts on the pads and he nudges it to the on side
strays down the leg side
effortless! That's vintage Gayle, he stays at the crease and merely lofts through the line and sends the ball about 10 rows back over the sight screen
fires it across the left hander from round the wicket and Gayle trickles it wide of short fine-leg off his pads
pushed in quick and he shuffles and clips it away down to deep square leg
gently clipped off the pads to deep midwicket
pushed it quick but down the leg side
rocks back, waits for the turn and slams it down to long-off
he reads the straighter one in the last minute, stays back and defends
makes room and he slams the top spinner wide of mid-off
stays back, waits for the turn and punches it hard down to long-off
sharp turn from middle and the keeper collects it down the leg side, Gayle lets it go
gets a thick top edge off the slog sweep and luckily the ball drops short of fine leg
turn straightaway and Shukla checks his shot and steers it to point
short of a length and driven off the backfoot to mid-off
lands on middle and leg and he chops it hard down to mid-on
full outside off and pushed hard down to the covers
he rocks back and what appeared initially as a mis-hit found its way about 10 rows back over long-on
that's a nonchalant jab which clears mid-off quite comfortably, he stays at the crease and makes firm contact, typical Gayle
comes on a lot quicker and Gayle half heartedly chops it back down the pitch
stays back and punches it against the turn to mid-on
tries to pull it away but finds Munaf at short fine leg
stays back and punches it back to the bowler
slides down the leg side and wide called
Dropped, He gets a thick top edge while attempting a slog and the ball swirls in the air for an eternity, Rawat wants it but he fluffs the catch
big appeal for a catch! The ball turns and bounces and Shukla nearly inside edges it onto his pads, the keeper claims a catch and Erasmus shakes his head

McCullum tries to take him downtown but he ends up lofting it off the toe edge of the bat, he fails to get the required distance to clear cover and Kamran pedals backwards, takes the catch over his head and falls backwards
he hoicks him across the line but isn't in full control of the shot as the ball lands just wide of midwicket
fullish outside off and he steers it to the off side or a run
he stays at the crease and gives it the treatment again, he takes Mascarenhas downtown and sends the ball about ten rows back this time
finally Gayle breaks the shackles by chipping down the track and lofting him across the line, he deposits it 20 rows back at deep midwicket
he flashes hard at a delivery angling across him and misses it completely
full on the pads and easily worked away to deep midwicket, there's protection in the deep, Warne's trying something different and it seems to be working
bowls it quick and keeps Gayle quiet as he gets forward to defend
taps it to the off side and Gayle limps to the other end, he's in some discomfort
gets it to really kick up off a good length and he hops at the crease and taps it to the off side
a bit of turn this time and he gets an inside edge to the on side
bowls it flat and quick and McCullum checks his punch to the off side
keeps it full outside off and a circumspect Gayle is content shouldering arms
keeps it full on middle and off and he pushes it firmly back to the bowler
keeps it just outside the offstump and Gayle is happy to let it go
angles it on the pads and he clips it away to the on side
this one seams away quite sharply after pitching and keeps low as well, he does well to let it go
curves the ball back in and has McCullum feeling for it outside off, well bowled
poor delivery outside off, too full and begging to be hit and he crashes it past the gap between cover and mid-off
opens the face of the bat and steers it softly to the off side
gets across and softly pushes it to the off side
flicked away wide of Munaf at square leg and they take two
strays on the pads and he clips it softly to the on side
gets turn and bounce and the big man is beaten
squares him up with turn and he gets a leading edge which lands on the off side
